description: Department of Fiscal Policy -  Excise Duty on Import of non-potabal  spiritis
reasoning: This gazette notification amends excise duty regulations for non-potable spirits imports under the Excise Ordinance. It contains a legal/regulatory amendment (Excise Notification No. 12/2018) that modifies previous regulations, specifies conditions for duty exemptions for export-oriented manufacturing companies, and establishes compliance requirements. While it mentions Minister Mangala Samaraweera, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers to make regulatory changes rather than detailing his portfolio responsibilities or making a personnel appointment. The core content is regulatory in nature, falling under Legal/Regulatory classification.
